summary: Iteration 3 Playwright UI verification of Track Editor, Silence Trim, Share Playlists (export/import), Talk Ducking, and Schedule features, plus full regression. All 16 test assertions passed against the deployed preview URL. Backend intentionally skipped (client-only app).

issues: Pre-existing benign React hydration warning caused by Emergent instrumentation injecting a <span> inside <option>. Not caused by app code (seen in iter 2 too).

verified_flows.regression_create_playlist: new-playlist-button -> new-playlist-input('Morning Show') -> confirm-create-playlist -> current-playlist-name='Morning Show'.
verified_flows.regression_upload_3_wavs: add-files-input(set_input_files) alpha/beta/gamma.wav -> 3 rows render with non '--:--' durations (0:03, 0:02, 0:02).
verified_flows.regression_play_track_0: play-track-0 -> ON AIR indicator visible, current-time advances beyond 0:00.
verified_flows.editor_open_waveform: Hover track-row-0 -> edit-track-0 -> track-editor-modal appears; Waveform canvas (data-testid='waveform') renders after decode.
verified_flows.editor_trim_and_auto_silence: editor-set-out / editor-set-in work; editor-auto-silence on alpha.wav (with 1s lead silence) sets In>0 and Out shows correct duration (Set In (0:00) shown due to formatTime rounding of ~1s point, Out=0:03).
verified_flows.editor_cut_sections: editor-mark-cut-start after seeking to 30% -> editor-mark-cut-end at 50% -> editor-cut-list chip appears; editor-remove-cut-0 removes it.
verified_flows.editor_save_wav: editor-format=wav -> editor-save -> modal closes, playlist grows from 3 -> 4 tracks; new row named 'alpha (edited).wav' shown as WAV.
verified_flows.editor_save_mp3: Reopen editor on same track, editor-format=mp3 -> editor-save (lamejs encoder ~1-2s) -> modal closes, playlist has 'alpha (edited).mp3' row tagged MP3. Both formats save without error.
verified_flows.silence_trim_toggle: trim-silence-toggle click flips button class from muted border to amber (border-[var(--hl-amber)] active). No crashes.
verified_flows.talk_button_and_hotkey_T: talk-button click sets 'hl-onair-dot' + red background (active); second click releases. Hotkey 'T' with body focus toggles the same active state.
verified_flows.auto_duck_toggle: auto-duck-toggle click -> in this headless harness getUserMedia resolves with a fake stream so the button turns active (border-onair, red bg). No 'Microphone access denied' banner needed. Both outcomes are acceptable per spec.
verified_flows.export_playlist_download: export-playlist-button triggers a download named 'Morning Show.hlp.json'. Captured file parses as JSON with keys ['app','version','name','tracks'].
verified_flows.import_playlist: set_input_files on import-playlist-input with the captured .hlp.json -> new playlist appended in sidebar (count 1 -> 2), becomes selected, track-count='5 tracks' (matches export at that moment, which included the two edited copies).
verified_flows.schedule_and_persist: hover playlist -> schedule-playlist-<id> opens schedule-modal, schedule-enabled-toggle ON, schedule-start=08:30, schedule-end=10:00, schedule-save -> schedule-badge-<id> shows '08:30–10:00' under playlist. After full page reload the badge is still present with the same times (localStorage persistence works).
verified_flows.hotkeys_ignored_in_input: With new-playlist-input focused, pressing Space does NOT toggle play (play-pause-button title stays 'Play') and the space character IS inserted into the input value.

critical_code_review_comments: TrackEditor.js: audio element on 'timeupdate' resets to inPoint and pauses when currentTime >= outPoint — good, but there is no cleanup on outPoint decreasing past currentTime while playing (would immediately jump). Minor; not a bug in test.
TrackEditor.doExport uses lamejs synchronously in bufferToMp3 — will block main thread for larger files. Acceptable for short clips but consider a Worker for multi-minute tracks.
ScheduleModal uses <input type='time'> which shows browser-native picker (per spec/desktop app this is fine; not a shadcn calendar case).
Sidebar import-playlist-input has no size/schema guard beyond onImportPlaylist — recommend validating JSON shape ('app', 'version') before applying to avoid corrupting localStorage on bad file.
PlayerBar crossfade-seconds emits pre-existing React warning about <span> inside <option> from Emergent instrumentation (not the app's code). No functional impact but pollutes console.
seed_data_creation: Generated three 2-second 22.05kHz mono WAV files at /tmp/wavs/{alpha,beta,gamma}.wav via python wave; alpha.wav has 1s leading silence to exercise auto-trim silence.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL from frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Client-only app; always localStorage.clear() and delete IndexedDB databases before test runs. Editor row actions (edit-track-N) require hovering track-row-N first (opacity-0 until hover). MP3 save can take up to ~30s in the harness; use a long detach timeout on track-editor-modal. Export download works via page.expect_download() and produces '<playlist>.hlp.json' with keys app/version/name/tracks — the captured file can be re-uploaded through import-playlist-input to test import round-trip. Headless Chromium here grants a fake mic so auto-duck-toggle turns active (no denial banner). Schedule badge persists after reload via localStorage. Editor-current-time / Set In text uses mm:ss with rounding, so a ~1s silence trim may still display as '(0:00)' for Set In text while internally >0.
